title: Tailoring Allowance on a Finch Circle Card Floor — Alterations Shop Note
content:
**Note.** For a card floor in the Finch Circle Loyalty Program, the floor tailoring allowance is 10.00 when the customer has dropped off three or more (3 or more) alteration tickets in the last 12 whole months, 5.00 when one or two, and 0.00 when none.

The tickets counted are the customer's Marlowe & Finch Alterations tickets whose drop-off date falls within the last 12 whole months.

| Alteration tickets dropped off in the last 12 whole months | Floor tailoring allowance (USD) |
|---|---|
| 3 or more | 10.00 |
| 1 or 2 | 5.00 |
| none | 0.00 |

## Cases (hypothetical)

- A suit hem in March, a dress taken in in June and a coat sleeve in September, all within the last 12 whole months: three tickets, 10.00.
- One bridal alteration ticket in the period: 5.00.
- A ticket dropped off 13 months ago and none since: 0.00.
